title: 第015章 上古御兽术第016章 九重凝气境
content_zh:
“发生了什么？”
“那是苍云山脉，似有灵器出世！”
“快去争夺！”
一时间，整个苍云城都为之一震。
即便是城主府内，也是猛然凝神，一位管事顿时道：“寻常灵器我城主府可不在乎，但这光芒绝对是高阶灵器！”
高阶灵器仅次于圣器，对于城主府而言都珍稀不已。
一念如此，城主府也第一时间派出强者向着苍云山脉而去。
只是此时的苍云山脉中，一道道兽吼声响彻四方。
齐长剑、齐刀、齐长枪、花婆婆等齐家长老皆是与灵兽相对，即便是齐山等人，也遭受了野兽的围堵。
“哼！”
这一刻，齐刀冷喝，手中灵刀呼啸直接将一头灵兽砍伤。
不得不说，其六重洞灵境的修为身怀刀灵体再加上这把灵刀即便是在苍云城中也鲜有对手。
只是灵兽也不是吃素的，身上鲜血滴落的一刻其眼眸赤红无比，愈发疯狂。
齐刀等人凝眉，灵兽虽无法将他们伤到，但在此处拖得越久变数越大。
“全力出手，尽快解决！”齐刀开口。
“是！”齐家修炼者喝道，那杀伐也在这时更为浓郁。
“就是此刻！”
树梢之上，叶炎心中暗道。
此时不取，怕是再无机会。
咻！

一念如此，叶炎自储物袋内拿出一个斗篷而后飘然落下，脚一触地便猛然一动，直奔那灵器而去。
“得手！”
夜幕之下，叶炎一把将那灵器抓在手中随后放入到了储物袋内，随后心中暗道一声，直接向着远处而去。
“谁？”
“还有人在此？”
“竟敢夺我齐家之物，找死！”
齐刀、齐长剑等人看着这一幕，顿时怒吼。
但叶炎却不曾回头，疯狂奔跑，只是在心中却是暗道：“抢的就是你齐家！”
“该死！”
“齐长枪，这小子不知是谁，但实力似乎不强，务必将灵器带回来！”齐刀怒斥。
“是！”齐长枪乃是齐家的一位中年执事，身怀二重结丹境的修为，如今他猛然后退，而齐家的其他长老豁然上前与他所对的灵兽抗衡下来。
如此齐长枪等人也是彻底抽身出来，而在这时，齐山也将身前的一头野兽诛杀，随后一动跟随齐长枪等人向着叶炎的方向追去。
咻咻咻……
叶炎此时速度施展到了极致，魂力也是高度集中。
只是他终究只是六重凝气境的修为，在速度上难以与结丹境的修炼者相比，百息之后齐长枪等人距离叶炎也是越来越近。
轰！
这一刻，齐长枪猛然一拍一根树上，瞬间将此树拍飞冲向叶炎而来。
面对着如此之树，叶炎也是一拳轰出。
嘭……
树木轰碎，但他的脚步也因此停滞下来。

“不管你是谁，在这苍云城内敢夺我齐家之物，便要死！”齐长枪开口，旋即冲来。
叶炎凝眉，旋即脚下一点猛然抬起，顿时间沙土飞扬迷失了对方的视线，随后叶炎脚步飞快再度向前而去。
“哼，凝气境的修为，也敢？”齐长枪气息一震，便将那等尘土化去，旋即再度追来。
齐山以及齐家其他的修炼者也是紧追不舍。
content_en:
"What happened?"
"That's the Cangyun Mountain Range. It seems like a spiritual weapon has been born!"
"Go and fight for it!"
For a moment, the entire Cangyun City was shocked.
Even in the City Lord's Mansion, he suddenly concentrated, and a steward suddenly said: "I, the City Lord's Mansion, don't care about ordinary spiritual weapons, but this light is definitely a high-level spiritual weapon!"
High-level spiritual weapons are second only to holy weapons and are extremely rare for the city lord's mansion.
As soon as he thought of this, the city lord's palace also immediately sent strong men towards the Cangyun Mountain Range.
But at this time, in the Cangyun Mountains, beast roars resounded in all directions.
Qi Changjian, Qi Dao, Qi Changqiang, Hua Granny and other elders of the Qi family all faced the spirit beasts. Even Qi Shan and others were also surrounded by the beasts.
"Hmph!"
At this moment, Qi Dao shouted coldly, and the spirit knife in his hand whizzed and directly chopped a spirit beast.
It has to be said that with his sixth-level cave spirit realm cultivation and sword-carrying spirit body, coupled with this spiritual sword, he has few opponents even in Cangyun City.
It's just that the spirit beast is not a vegetarian. The moment blood drips from its body, its eyes are extremely red and it becomes more and more crazy.
Qi Dao and others frowned. Although the spirit beast could not hurt them, the longer they stayed here, the greater the changes.
"Go with all your strength and solve it as soon as possible!" Qi Dao said.
"Yes!" The cultivator of the Qi family shouted, and the killing became more intense at this time.
"This is the moment!"
Above the treetops, Ye Yan secretly thought.
If you don’t take it now, I’m afraid you won’t have another chance.
call out!
With this thought, Ye Yan took out a cloak from his storage bag and floated it down. As soon as his feet touched the ground, he moved suddenly and headed straight for the spiritual weapon.
"Succeed!"
Under the cover of night, Ye Yan grabbed the spiritual weapon in his hand and put it into the storage bag. Then he secretly thought in his heart and went directly towards the distance.
"Who?"
"Is there anyone else here?"
"How dare you take away my Qi family's belongings? You are seeking death!"
Qi Dao, Qi Changjian and others looked at this scene and immediately roared.
But Ye Yan never looked back and ran wildly, but secretly thought in his heart: "The one I'm robbing is your Qi family!"
"Damn it!"
"Qi Changqiang, I don't know who this guy is, but he doesn't seem to be very strong. You must bring the spiritual weapon back!" Qi Dao yelled angrily.
"Yes!" Qi Changqiang is a middle-aged deacon of the Qi family, possessing the cultivation level of the second level of pill formation. Now he suddenly retreated, while other elders of the Qi family suddenly stepped forward to compete with the spiritual beast he was facing.
In this way, Qi Changqiang and others were able to completely withdraw. At this moment, Qi Shan also killed a beast in front of him, and then followed Qi Changqiang and others in the direction of Ye Yan.
Boo hoo hoo…
Ye Yan's speed was at its peak at this time, and his soul power was also highly concentrated.
It's just that after all, he is only at the sixth level of Qi Condensation Realm, and it is difficult to compare with the practitioners of the Core Formation Realm in terms of speed. After a hundred breaths, Qi Changqiang and others are getting closer and closer to Ye Yan.
boom!
At this moment, Qi Changqiang suddenly hit a tree, instantly sending the tree flying towards Ye Yan.
Facing such a tree, Ye Yan also punched out.
Bang...
The trees shattered, but his steps stopped as a result.
"No matter who you are, if you dare to take something from my Qi family in Cangyun City, you will die!" Qi Changqiang said and rushed over immediately.
Ye Yan frowned, and then his feet suddenly lifted up. For a moment, the sand and dust flew up and lost the opponent's sight, and then Ye Yan quickly moved forward again.
"Hmph, you dare to be in the Qi Condensation Realm?" Qi Changqiang shook his breath, turned the dust away, and immediately pursued him again.
Qi Shan and other cultivators from the Qi family were also hot on their heels.
